svg.aria-label: How I work: 1. Chat: You tell me what you need and who the site is for. 2. Plan: I confirm the pages, features and timeline before I start. 3. Build: I build it and send you updates along the way. You’re never left guessing. 4. Revise: You review, I adjust until you’re happy. 5. Launch: I help get your site live and answer questions after delivery. “When I work with a client, I always keep them updated on their website.”
